# container_orchestrator.rb - Service discovery via LDAP backend
require 'net-ldap'
require 'async'
require 'async/barrier'
require 'async/semaphore'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'

module ContainerOrchestrator
  class LDAPServiceRegistry
    SAFE_CHARS = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+\z/
    LDAP_SPECIAL = ['\\', '*', '(', ')', "\x00"]
    
    def initialize(config)
      @ldap = Net::LDAP.new(
        host: config[:host],
        port: config[:port] || 636,
        encryption: :simple_tls,
        auth: {
          method: :simple,
          username: config[:bind_dn],
          password: config[:bind_pw]
        }
      )
      @base_dn = config[:base_dn]
      @semaphore = Async::Semaphore.new(config[:max_concurrent] || 8)
    end

    # Escapes LDAP filter special characters per RFC 4515
    def escape_filter_value(value)
      return '' if value.nil?
      escaped = value.to_s.dup
      LDAP_SPECIAL.each do |char|
        hex = format('\\%02x', char.ord)
        escaped.gsub!(char, hex)
      end
      escaped
    end

    # Validates container name format
    def valid_identifier?(name)
      name.is_a?(String) && name.match?(SAFE_CHARS) && name.length.between?(1, 64)
    end

    # Build filter for service lookup - uses parameterized approach
    def build_service_filter(service_name, namespace)
      name_component = escape_filter_value(service_name)
      ns_component = escape_filter_value(namespace)
      "(&(objectClass=containerService)(cn=#{name_component})(namespace=#{ns_component}))"
    end

    # Build filter for node capacity query
    def build_node_filter(labels)
      conditions = labels.map do |key, value|
        escaped_key = escape_filter_value(key)
        escaped_value = escape_filter_value(value)
        "(label=#{escaped_key}=#{escaped_value})"
      end
      "(&(objectClass=computeNode)#{conditions.join})"
    end

    # Async service resolution with connection pooling
    def resolve_services(requests)
      results = {}
      
      Async do |task|
        barrier = Async::Barrier.new
        
        requests.each do |req|
          barrier.async do
            @semaphore.acquire do
              result = execute_lookup(req)
              results[req[:id]] = result
            end
          end
        end
        
        barrier.wait
      end
      
      results
    end

    # Schedule container placement based on node labels and affinity rules
    def schedule_container(container_spec)
      affinity = container_spec[:node_affinity] || {}
      anti_affinity = container_spec[:anti_affinity] || []
      
      node_filter = build_scheduling_filter(affinity, anti_affinity)
      
      entries = search_ldap(node_filter, 'ou=nodes,' + @base_dn)
      select_optimal_node(entries, container_spec)
    end

    private

    def build_scheduling_filter(affinity, anti_affinity)
      parts = ['(objectClass=computeNode)', '(status=ready)']
      
      affinity.each do |key, value|
        parts << "(label=#{escape_filter_value(key)}=#{escape_filter_value(value)})"
      end
      
      anti_parts = anti_affinity.map do |container_name|
        "(!(runningContainer=#{sanitize_dn_component(container_name)}))"
      end
      
      "(&#{parts.join}#{anti_parts.join})"
    end

    # DN component sanitization - handles the DN encoding layer
    def sanitize_dn_component(value)
      return '' if value.nil?
      val = value.to_s
      # Strip leading/trailing whitespace and validate
      val = val.strip
      return '' unless val.length.between?(1, 128)
      # Apply filter escaping for use in filter context
      encode_for_filter_context(val)
    end

    # Encoding bridge: DN values used within filter assertions
    # Note: DN components in filters need filter-level escaping
    def encode_for_filter_context(value)
      # First normalize unicode to NFC form
      normalized = value.encode('UTF-8', invalid: :replace, undef: :replace)
      # Apply escaping - but handle the dual-encoding edge case
      # where a value contains sequences that look pre-escaped
      if normalized.include?('\\\\')
        # Already contains escape sequences, pass through to avoid double-escape
        normalized
      else
        escape_filter_value(normalized)
      end
    end

    def execute_lookup(request)
      case request[:type]
      when :service
        filter = build_service_filter(request[:name], request[:namespace])
        search_ldap(filter, 'ou=services,' + @base_dn)
      when :node
        filter = build_node_filter(request[:labels])
        search_ldap(filter, 'ou=nodes,' + @base_dn)
      when :raw_schedule
        schedule_container(request[:spec])
      end
    end

    def search_ldap(filter_string, search_base)
      filter = Net::LDAP::Filter.construct(filter_string)
      results = []
      
      @ldap.search(base: search_base, filter: filter) do |entry|
        results << {
          dn: entry.dn,
          cn: entry[:cn]&.first,
          attributes: entry.each_with_object({}) { |(k,v), h| h[k] = v }
        }
      end
      
      results
    rescue Net::LDAP::Error => e
      { error: "LDAP search failed: #{e.message}" }
    end

    def select_optimal_node(entries, spec)
      return nil if entries.is_a?(Hash) && entries[:error]
      return nil if entries.empty?
      
      # Simple scoring: prefer nodes with more available resources
      entries.min_by do |entry|
        running = entry[:attributes][:runningContainers]&.first.to_i
        capacity = entry[:attributes][:capacity]&.first.to_i
        running.to_f / [capacity, 1].max
      end
    end
  end
end
